verdict.rationale: Ledgy publishes a GraphQL API reference, but it is a static SpectaQL-generated page with copy-paste curl examples. The evidence explicitly states there is no console and no test company, so nothing in the reference is interactive or runnable in place. A static reference is an adjacent feature and does not deliver the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
